entities.name: Marcus Krüger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcus Viktor Krüger is a Swedish professional ice hockey centreman. He is currently playing as captain for Djurgårdens IF Hockey of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He was drafted by the Chicago Blackhawks in the fifth round, 149th overall, in the 2009 NHL entry draft. He is a two-time Stanley Cup champion with the Blackhawks in 2013 and 2015.
